findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 138 requests to 16 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 3.5 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 2.6 MB (75%) came from third-party domains, 761 kB of it from services classified as tracking (31 requests).

5 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), mrf.io (Marfeel, analytics), newsroom.bi (Marfeel, analytics).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 5 requests were blocked. The page still made 138 requests to 16 third-party domains, including 5 tracking services in our list.
